source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
In the upper-right corner of the page, click View PC_File_Name_DATE.csv
3. Read the column headers (especially column D for inspector comments).
4. Scroll to the bottom of the page to the Records table. This table contains records of inspection entries for all inspected buildings in the specified date range.
5. Click on the + symbol to the left of an entry of the Records table to view the details found by this inspection.
6. Review the details found by this inspection:
Description: The name of the component.
Defect: A description of the defect.
Requirements: A short description of the relevant requirement, followed by a link to the accessibility standard (e.g., ADA, for Americans with Disabilities Act).
Recommendations: Describes possible steps to correct the noncompliant component.
Inspections: Acceptable is “Compliant” or “Unknown”; Unacceptable is “Noncompliant
